plans.idea: Classic split: the bottle sits large in the left 40%, and the right column reads top to bottom on one shared left edge: headline and subhead, then the badge pair, then the CTA, with legal set small at the foot.
Mirrored, text-led layout: a big left text block with the CTA and badges side by side on one baseline row beneath it, and the bottle filling the right side as a full-height visual anchor.

Faithful three-column banner like the original: the bottle on the left, the headline, subhead and badges in the centre column, and the CTA standing alone on the right at the text's optical centre, with legal running under the centre and right columns.
